description: ManPy (Manufacturing in Python) is a discrete-event simulation library of reusable objects, such as machines, queues, sources and exits, that users connect to model manufacturing systems, built on SimPy 3. It is the core of the DREAM platform, which adds a knowledge extraction tool for linking production data to the simulation, using rpy2, and a browser-based HTML5 graphical editor with Gantt charts. It was developed in the DREAM project, funded by the EU Seventh Framework Programme (grant 314364) to bring simulation-based decision support to European manufacturers, and is maintained by Nexedi, whose GitLab holds the primary repository with a mirror on GitHub. It applies to single plants and production lines. The code is free under the LGPL, with some components under GPL-3.0. Caveats: the project dates from the FP7 period and the mirror shows no recent release, so it is marked stale, and it needs programming skills to extend. For simulation it models production lines to test capacity, scheduling and the effect of machine outages, and can be embedded in wider supply-chain disruption studies. It is related to the SimPROCESD record in this catalogue, a newer discrete-event library with a maintenance focus.
